selection_rationale: Use the literature timescale at which beta-delayed fission becomes the primary fission channel; treat it as an abundance-weighted kinetic proxy rather than an isotope-specific half-life.
Use the GW170817 ejecta-mass estimate reported in the primary observational study.
Use the representative lower-average electron fraction reported by the merger-disc GRMHD model as the literature prior center; retain the broad-distribution caveat.
Use the joint GW-EM viewing-angle median of 32 degrees after conversion to the requested radian execution unit.
Human-reviewed Monte Carlo sample-count baseline for the Q2 posterior run.
Human-reviewed number of independent chains for convergence diagnostics.
